nodes.label: Layered Architecture
nodes.rationale: Four-layer design (UI -> Controller -> Service -> Infrastructure) with strict downward-only calls so the UI never touches infrastructure directly and services never reference UI widgets.

nodes.label: Thread and Process Model
nodes.rationale: QProcess for external CLI tools (ffmpeg, whisper) and QThread worker objects for internal Python processing; UI never accesses worker internals, JobController aggregates signals.

nodes.label: Processing Pipeline (8 stages)
nodes.rationale: Original Phase-0 design had 8 stages; shipped v1.0.1 has 7 (frame extraction/detection/dedup merged into Detect Slides) and export is user-triggered.

nodes.label: State Management & Crash Recovery
nodes.rationale: state.json written atomically (tmp then os.replace); running jobs reclassified as interrupted on startup; resume skips completed stages.

nodes.label: Slide Detection Cascade (dHash/SSIM/histogram)
nodes.rationale: Designed as three-stage tiered cascade; shipped detector uses a rolling motion baseline with two-path decision and combined score 0.4·ssim + 0.3·dhash + 0.3·pixel_diff.

nodes.label: External Binary Strategy
nodes.rationale: ffmpeg/ffprobe/whisper-cli bundled and resolved at runtime via sys._MEIPASS; never on system PATH (AD-4).

nodes.label: Whisper Backend Selection
nodes.rationale: CPU primary path; Vulkan optional accelerator chosen via settings or auto-probe recording backend_used.

nodes.label: Layered Transcript & Context Repair
nodes.rationale: Four-layer model (raw / normalized / context proposals / user-approved); Context Repair uses local OpenAI-compatible LLM or a deterministic approved-name provider.

nodes.label: packaged_visual_acceptance.py (beta.10 gate)
nodes.rationale: One standalone acceptance runner exercising the real Windows executable, recording the top-level window via Win32/mss, CDP telemetry, and gdigrab recording.

nodes.label: Beta.10 visual gate three-run evidence
nodes.rationale: ok:true across 3 runs; zero flash/black/resize/sidebar/Demo flags; render telemetry ~(154-156, 9, 0, 0) per run.

nodes.label: Demo processing spotlight geometry fix
nodes.rationale: Synchronous positionTourSpotlight() call at end of renderPipeline() while processing Demo phase active; smallest fix, no animation/GPU change.

nodes.label: Reopen runtime overlay fix (RuntimeSetupGate)
nodes.rationale: Close the checking overlay before the checking-state return only when HEALTHY and setup_acknowledged, preserving the five-row first-launch checklist.

nodes.label: Opaque native and WebEngine surfaces (beta.11)
nodes.rationale: QMainWindow/QWebEngineView kept non-translucent and auto-filled; _sync_page_background applies active theme; app.css html/body/#app opaque. Addresses clean-install flicker.

nodes.label: Static Demo spotlight (no spread-shadow scrim)
nodes.rationale: Replaced 9999px box-shadow dimmer with fixed translucent scrim + highlight border + arrow repositioned only via requestAnimationFrame; no blur/drop-shadow/large spread. AD-20 constraint.

nodes.label: Processing repaint coalescing (250ms scheduler)
nodes.rationale: Caps visible processing updates at 4/sec; skips identical snapshots, updates rows in place, preserves log scroll, DocumentFragment appends.

nodes.label: Beta 15 PC bug report (8 items)
nodes.rationale: User-reported defects: instant thumbnails, false 'transcribing audio' idle label, default Electron taskbar icon, drag-and-drop moves whole card not thumbnail, missing yt-dlp, stale processing card after demo, glow overlay only on Home, transcription overlaying timestamps.

nodes.label: Beta 9 root theme / first-frame compositor alignment
nodes.rationale: Theme set on document root (data-theme), not #app; _apply_initial_theme_before_show injects to documentElement; centralWidget installed before view.load.

nodes.label: Beta 9 startup scrollbar / setup-overlay stability
nodes.rationale: body width 100%; no document overflow mutation; RuntimeSetupGate render(dataChanged) guard + in-place rows; closeOverlay routes via motion helper.

nodes.label: Beta 9 pipeline/log/status update throttling
nodes.rationale: schedulePipelineRender coalescing; log innerHTML dirty-check; setStatusDotText in-place updates; adapter _last_pipeline_payload + _last_stage_progress dedupe.

nodes.label: AD-1: QProcess for external tools, QThread for internal processing
AD-5: Deterministic CV pipeline for slide detection (no LLM)
AD-8: PyInstaller over Nuitka for initial packaging
AD-19: Beta 9 WebView Compositor and Live-Update Reliability
nodes.rationale: Root/compositor and dedupe decision for the beta 9 flashing fix.

nodes.label: AD-20: no spread-shadow scrim / static spotlight
nodes.rationale: Beta.10 smooth on dev machine but flickered/lagged on a separate clean-install Windows machine; --disable-gpu changed nothing, so not GPU-specific and will not reproduce locally. Bans spread-shadow scrims, geometry transitions on tour elements, will-change, drop-shadow filters.

nodes.label: AD-23: Isolated Electron Renderer Spike (experiment only)
nodes.rationale: Diagnostic fork isolating static/mocked/python-handshake electron modes to distinguish black-interval causes; not an automatic product migration.

nodes.label: AD-26: Phase 8 Electron Production App Core
AD-46: Route AI-first Study through a payload-minimizing server gateway
nodes.rationale: ai-gateway Cloudflare Worker is the only desktop HTTPS client; fixed task allowlist, provider/model never accepted from student, D1 stores metadata only, no transcripts/prompts/images persisted.

nodes.label: AD-47: full-schema NVIDIA routes first, cooldown unhealthy routes
nodes.rationale: meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct for text, nvidia/nemotron-nano-12b-v2-vl for vision; OpenRouter first only for web_enrichment (citation authority); measured sequential fastest-first reduces latency under 175s desktop deadline.

nodes.label: AD-48: Guided demo is a self-contained screen with pre-baked real output
nodes.rationale: Eight spotlight-tour fixes did not converge; replaced overlay with a screen that measures nothing and mutates nothing outside it. Data ships as a script-loaded global (window.LP_DEMO_DATA) because fetch() of a sibling is blocked under file://.

nodes.label: AD-50: Asynchronous Study work uses per-job cancellation epochs
nodes.rationale: Sidecar owns monotonic per-job Study epoch; demo cleanup/deletion advance it; checks before/after provider work and before persistence; manifest guard confines cleanup.

nodes.label: AD-51: Release visual evidence proves unobscured minimum-width layouts
nodes.rationale: Review timeline header wraps below 700px; 640x480 supported without clipping; checks scrollWidth+overlay; MIT LICENSE required as explicit release resource.

nodes.label: AD-52: Clean-machine acceptance uses a persisted job and always unwinds its install
nodes.rationale: Clean-machine validator must inspect persisted transcript/export so it imports installed media as a normal job; finally-cleanup invokes exact uninstaller; avoids polluting registry/Send To.

nodes.label: AD-53: Guided-demo output and recovery UI are exact packaged contracts
nodes.rationale: Packager copies curated data module/hero/slides/thumbnail/provenance to resources/assets/demo; release fails if any required asset absent; Entrance through Settings Replay; quiz correctness has textual result.

nodes.label: Electron bridge contract (electron-bridge-contract.json)
nodes.rationale: Phase 9 locks final command/event names + payloads so the Electron UI can be built against it; operations flip DEFERRED -> IMPLEMENTED(production_core:true) per feature commit.

nodes.label: Phase 8 implemented bridge core operations (34)
nodes.rationale: bootstrap, list/restore jobs, import, start/cancel, slides/transcript, exports, errors, shutdown implemented in python-sidecar.py + production-main.js.

nodes.label: Phase 9 deferred operations (no-ops)
nodes.rationale: media_*, update_*, Ollama, Groq, GPU, queue, notifications left as no-ops/interception and must not be re-enabled for Phase 8.

nodes.label: Bridge incompatibilities / remediation notes
nodes.rationale: jobs_changed envelope stripped by eventPayload(); theme is renderer-local via localStorage; get_settings is a noop; four Phase 8 core gaps implemented in production seam.

nodes.label: Electron Renderer Migration Spike
nodes.rationale: Isolated diagnostic fork (Static/Mocked/Python-engine modes) reusing the real frontend to distinguish black-interval causes; affected-laptop is the acceptance authority.

nodes.label: Mode 2 Mocked LecturePack frontend stress (mock-workload.js)
nodes.rationale: Most important stress mode; real HTML/CSS/JS with deterministic local signals, 500 log rows, resizes/theme toggles.

nodes.label: Mode 3 Python sidecar JSONL handshake (python-sidecar.py)
nodes.rationale: Safe local process spawn of PyInstaller sidecar importing LecturePack engine; heartbeat ping/describe/shutdown; does not run real jobs.

nodes.label: Electron Migration Vertical Slice
nodes.rationale: Turns the spike seam into one real portable path: health -> import bundled demo -> real FFmpeg/whisper -> slides/transcript -> Study Pack export -> close -> reopen restore. Headless QCoreApplication sidecar, exact PID tree cleanup.

nodes.label: Sidecar JSONL contract
nodes.rationale: Commands health_check/list_jobs/import_video/start_job/cancel_job/get_job/get_slides/get_transcript/export/shutdown; response event echoes request_id in response_to; unsolicited events never depend on an open request.

nodes.label: Electron packaged-app acceptance gate (12 requirements)
nodes.rationale: Verifies launch, sidecar ready, runtime paths, demo import, processing, slides/transcript, export, clean close, relaunch restore, no orphans, clean logs. Covers production-*.jsonl evidence + sidecar JSONL.

nodes.label: Disposable-data protection (refuses user LecturePackData)
nodes.rationale: Runner exits 2 before doing anything when pointed at any user LecturePackData path; only runs against explicit --data-dir.

nodes.label: Electron production host (production-main.js)
nodes.rationale: Single entry point; one opaque BrowserWindow shown on ready-to-show; starts sidecar; restores newest persisted job; taskkill /T /F fallback on non-exit.

nodes.label: Packaged headless sidecar (QCoreApplication only)
nodes.rationale: No QtWidgets/WebEngine; PySide6 retained because controller imports QProcess/QThread/QTimer; CPU runtime resolved from resource root; persists via existing Job/controller.

nodes.label: Job-scoped workspace ownership + freshness guard (BUG-08)
nodes.rationale: LP.state.jobId owns workspace; _set_active_job is the only assignment site; _emit stamps every job-scoped payload with owner id and ownsPayload() drops late payloads from a previous lecture.

nodes.label: Poster thumbnails pipeline (lpasset:// poster host)
nodes.rationale: Lazy cheapest-source-first: existing slide frame else one ffmpeg grab ~10% in, seeking before -i; prewarmed on jobs_changed.

nodes.label: Import from link (yt-dlp, optional dependency)
nodes.rationale: media_fetch.py service + lazy is_available() gating so builds without yt-dlp hide the button rather than failing at startup.

nodes.label: Design tokens (--on-signal / --*-fill / motion tokens)
nodes.rationale: Additive token work; motion follows PRODUCT register (subtle, 120-240ms, one curve, no perpetual motion).

nodes.label: BUG-09: worker-thread signals never delivered (_emit_soon)
nodes.rationale: QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda) starts the timer in the calling thread (no Qt loop) so it never fires; fix passes a main-thread QObject as context argument.

nodes.label: Light-theme WCAG AA sweep (11 failing pairs)
nodes.rationale: Four light tokens darkened (--muted, --green, --red, --orange-ink); Icons via SVG stroke set colour, missed by color:#fff greps; icons now use var(--on-signal).

nodes.label: Pre-release review (3 blockers + 5 high-severity defects)
nodes.rationale: BUG-11 unreachable tray wiring, BUG-12 storage_changed missing from bridge SIGNALS, BUG-13 unthrottled data-root walk, BUG-14 data-loss escalation, BUG-15 fabricated Giza lecture, BUG-16 no Source card writer, BUG-17 previous-download import, BUG-18 cancelled download became a job.

nodes.label: BUG-14: Recycle-Bin delete escalated to permanent on failure
nodes.rationale: Broad except Exception around send2trash silently escalated a Recycle-Bin delete to a permanent rmtree — data loss. 'Fail, don't escalate.'

nodes.label: MOTION SYSTEM v1 (reusable class set)
nodes.rationale: Refined neobrutalist: ~112 solid 2px borders, no gradients, flat fills; motion animates only transform/opacity/bg/border/shadow; one card class set, no per-screen keyframes.

nodes.label: Hard-shadow physical press (.lp-press)
nodes.rationale: Hard offset shadow collapses to flat on :active while button translates; deliberately avoids scale(0.96) which resamples 2px borders. 14 of 20 buttons had inline box-shadow making the class inert — removed inline only.

nodes.label: Screen navigation via document.startViewTransition
nodes.rationale: Root-only cross-fade layer; no per-element view-transition-name; inline screen animations removed because specificity had been hard-cutting screens.

nodes.label: MOTION SYSTEM v2 (mechanical, replaces v1)
nodes.rationale: Objects have mass and hard edges, travel on ONE axis, stop hard; --motion-spring single movement curve; View Transition layer removed (async callback caused indicator bug); transform-only entrance keyframes.

nodes.label: Button character reaching all 88 buttons (box-shadow+transform only)
nodes.rationale: 75/88 buttons carry inline border/background/color which beat class rules; character built from box-shadow+transform only; no pale outlines anywhere.

nodes.label: Dark palette rework
nodes.rationale: Surfaces lightened so pitch-black shadow reads; retuned --muted/--nav-ink/--line as consequence; light theme byte-identical.

nodes.label: BUG-26: imported video thumbnail never appears
nodes.rationale: poster.webp exists on disk but monitor logged a 404 for the poster URL after the file existed — points at resolver or a stale cached app.js; owner chose to release.

nodes.label: Drag-and-drop to re-process finished lectures
nodes.rationale: Finished/failed/cancelled/interrupted lectures draggable; reprocess behind confirm dialog; mapCall allowlist dropped 'reprocess' silently — derive the transport allowlist from call sites.

nodes.label: Guided demo: PRESETS['demo'] selection fix
nodes.rationale: _preset() whitelist silently returned balanced so demo got 2 slides instead of 4; both halves needed (set at import + prevent _start_job from re-applying balanced).

nodes.label: Pre-built demo Study cache (study-content-v2.json)
nodes.rationale: Cache not fake; guarded on demo video SHA-256 + transcript/slide counts; force=True bypasses; regenerable via scripts/capture_demo_study_cache.py.

nodes.label: Study pack expansion dead everywhere (two silent gates)
nodes.rationale: expand_concept_material never added to TASK_TYPES (ValueError, silent) and never deployed; both hidden by except Exception: continue. Every Study pack stuck at 2 flashcards/3 questions.

nodes.label: Group study foundation (map-reduce over lecture summaries)
nodes.rationale: README reduce over each lecture's persisted lecture_analysis (~1KB each) — one request over N small summaries, not N transcripts. group_analysis is the only stronger-model task, excluded from NVIDIA_FIRST_TASKS.

nodes.label: Group reduce cache fingerprint
nodes.rationale: Cache fingerprint = job id + each pack's generated_at, so re-processing one lecture invalidates a group map; order-normalised.

nodes.label: sol/release-polish is the single release line
nodes.rationale: Divergent-lineage worry was wrong; settled with git merge-base --is-ancestor v2.0.1 0646a14 (exit 0) and empty git log 0646a14..v2.0.1. One commit (8404ddc) cherry-picked.

nodes.label: BUG-42: M3 suite tested nothing it claimed (wrong fixture assumptions)
nodes.rationale: Fixture used wrong filename/status/id; load_content() normalised unknown statuses; sidecar reads request_id not id. Reference product constants and drive the real wire protocol.

nodes.label: Inno Setup was installed all along (per-user path)
nodes.rationale: ISCC.exe at C:\Users\marsh\AppData\Local\Programs\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe (per-user, not on PATH); checks of Program Files/PATH were blind to it. Never report it missing.

nodes.label: BUG-43: group study could never have worked (two independent faults)
nodes.rationale: Deployed Worker stale (8 tasks, no group_analysis -> HTTP 400) and response envelope never unwrapped (group_study.prepare handed envelope to normalize). Two regression tests pin the real envelope.

nodes.label: CI cannot build this product (bin/ gitignored, no fetch step)
nodes.rationale: bin/ (ffmpeg, ffprobe, whisper-cli, model) gitignored and no workflow fetches it, so releases only cut from this one machine; fix is hosting the payload (GH release asset or R2) + fetch/checksum.

nodes.label: End-to-end MVP pipeline (verified)
nodes.rationale: Asynchronous stages keep Qt responsive; three-stage slide cascade; job persistence via manifest.json; verified on real whisper-cli + 1080p clip, 7 slides 100%, ~30s pipeline.

nodes.label: SSIM deduplication guard (>=0.95 similarity)
nodes.rationale: Avoided collapsing visually different slides sharing flat similar backgrounds by verifying downscaled SSIM score in final local dedup loop.

nodes.label: Guided demo rebuilt as a self-contained screen
nodes.rationale: data-screen="demo" with five chapters swapped by [hidden]; shows pre-baked real Polar Bears output (demo.data.js + real slide PNGs); pipeline runs after walkthrough via explicit button.

nodes.label: file:// fetch trap (window.LP_DEMO_DATA global)
nodes.rationale: Renderer loaded via loadFile so fetch('../assets/demo/demo.json') is blocked under file:// with web security; degraded to fallback silently. Fixed by shipping as a <script>-loaded global.

nodes.label: Two bottom bars consolidated into one status bar
nodes.rationale: proc-strip and status footer showed the same running job twice; strip deleted, contributions folded into footer; fixed 34px height every state.

nodes.label: AI Study waiting state shows real stage sequence
nodes.rationale: Renderer previously discarded the stage sequence ai_study_service emits; now renders complete/running/pending; unrecognised stage renders as running so a new backend stage never looks broken.

nodes.label: Tour dim-region seam fix (BUG-41)
nodes.rationale: Right dim rect spanned full viewport height so both right corners painted twice (~.878) while left painted once; setTourDimRect with left+width start and viewportWidth-left-width extent.

nodes.label: Widened tour step contract (prepare/target/keepClear/reveals/present)
nodes.rationale: TOUR_PHASES entries carry prepare (run once on entry), target (selector or array union hole), keepClear, reveals, present ('card' or 'tip'). Every gap between declaration and reality was a geometry bug.

nodes.label: Review stacked-column height fix (slide-list 0 height)
nodes.rationale: max-height does not make height definite; flex:1 child resolved to 0 at stacked sizes below 1220px; changed to height:230px -> 134px at every stacked size.

nodes.label: Study tour step retarget (Study V2 overview actions)
nodes.rationale: Original target #demo-study-actions sat inside hidden #study-legacy; retargeted to #demo-study-actions-v2 (inline-flex shrink-wrap) and re-measured on mode restore.

nodes.label: Dead Study buttons (precondition re-run loop)
nodes.rationale: prepare() ran at top of positionTourSpotlight every rAF/resize/scroll, forcing mode back; applyTourStepPrecondition() now runs once per step keyed on phase. Symptom: dead-looking buttons with no error.

nodes.label: Footer waiting-state label (Review ready / Ready to export)
nodes.rationale: friendlyProcessingLabel collapsed review ready onto 'Preparing review'; label now resolves from app state waitingHandoff() with two parked states at 86%.

nodes.label: AD-24: Explicit Electron Migration Vertical Slice
nodes.rationale: Decision to build the explicit Electron migration vertical slice as an isolated migration slice with an affected-laptop acceptance gate.

nodes.label: Headless sidecar (python-sidecar.py, QCoreApplication)
nodes.rationale: Headless adapter around the existing engine; imports no QtWidgets/WebEngine, creates no window; stdin reader starts only after engine bootstrap to avoid Windows pipe-read starvation.

hyperedges.label: Flashing/flicker fix lineage (beta9 -> beta10 -> beta11 -> AD-20)
